The full test suite passes (256 tests, 0 failures). 

## Summary

I implemented rejection of duplicate owner creation with a 409 response.

**Changes:**

1. **`ClinicService`** — added `boolean existsIdenticalOwner(Owner owner)` to the service contract.

2. **`ClinicServiceImpl`** — implemented it (transactional, read-only): it looks up owners by last name and checks whether any existing owner matches on all five identity fields (first name, last name, address, city, telephone) via a private `isSameIdentity` helper using `Objects.equals`.

3. **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner`** — before saving, it now returns `HttpStatus.CONFLICT` (409) when `existsIdenticalOwner` is true; otherwise it creates the owner as before.

4. **`OwnerRestControllerV1Tests`** — added `createOwnerDuplicateConflict` asserting 409 for a duplicate. I also had to adjust the pre-existing `createOwnerSuccess` test: it posted "George Franklin / 110 W. Liberty St. / Madison / 6085551023", which is exactly seed owner #1 — under the new spec that is a genuine duplicate, so it can no longer return 201. It now posts a unique owner. A small `uniqueName` helper generates letters-only unique names (the owner name Bean Validation pattern rejects digits).

**Note on scope:** duplicate detection lives at the V1 `addOwner` endpoint, which is the only owner-creation endpoint (the V2 controller exposes listing only, no create).
